channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Dumars | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Dumars from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars
item.description:
Benson:

“I hired Joe Dumars because we needed a change in leadership at that top level of the Pelicans. I believe in Joe, and Joe knows exactly the stats you noted. We need to improve immediately. Our roster is built for success right now. I will rely on Joe to make these decisions and changes as he sees fit.”

Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars, Nov 14, 2025. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars, Willie Green
item.description:
Benson:

“I really like Willie Green, but I hired Joe Dumars to assess our basketball operation. And that’s what he is doing. He is assessing Willie and all the players. He and I spent the entire halftime (of the Portland Trail Blazers game on Wednesday night) talking. When he makes a decision, that's up to him. That's why I hired him. I trust Joe, because I feel like he knows people. He's known Willie since he was a child, so they know each other. And if he can fix that problem, then he'll fix it. If he can't, then that'll be his decision, not mine. I've left that in his hands.”

Gayle Benson on Joe Dumars, Willie Green, Nov 14, 2025. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish
item.description:
Miller was a five-time All-Star, with his first All-Star selection coming in 1990 in Miami in just his third NBA season.

“I remember in 1990 walking into the locker room for the first time, and there's Larry (Bird) and there's Isiah (Thomas) and there was Jordan and there was Joe Dumars and there was Robert Parish, there was Charles (Barkley), Patrick (Ewing),”

Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Feb 16, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Zeljko Obradovic on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“To be honest, I never had a concrete offer from the NBA. In all honesty, I [once] spent 40 days as part of the Detroit Pistons organization. It's the best league in the world. They take [some coaching details] from us, and we take from them. I had the opportunity to be part of the team, I even received daily wages. When I arrived, [general manager] Joe Dumars told me he wanted me to talk about all the details I was seeing. We talked about a possible arrangement, but those are some things between us,”

Zeljko Obradovic on Joe Dumars, Sep 22, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Joe Dumars, Rick Mahorn
item.description:
Jerry Stackhouse:

“I was able to be in the locker room with Rick Mahorn and Joe Dumars. Those guys were men. They taught you how to be a professional. Nothing against Philadelphia, but I was with a lot of young guys. When I got here, that was my first sense that I was around some pros, guys that knew how to go about their business. I learned from them and I was able to share that with other young guys that came through the organization. I think some of those ingredients kind of carried through and we were kind of the bridge between those two eras.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Joe Dumars, Rick Mahorn, Jul 26, 2022. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Chris Webber on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“It’s been frustrating to watch. I think everyone tried their best and I’m very happy that at least in the interim — Joe Dumars is a great leader and I think he’s consulting the team right now. So for me, as a Kings fan, it makes you feel a little bit better but you feel bad knowing that Vlade gave his all.”

Chris Webber on Joe Dumars, Aug 22, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Vlade Divac on Joe Dumars
item.description:
Kings GM Vlade Divac on the hiring of Joe Dumars:

“As an experienced and talented basketball executive, I’m excited to have him serve as a special advisor and expert resource for our incredible front office team.”

Vlade Divac on Joe Dumars, Jun 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @SeanCunningham.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Joe Dumars
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Chauncey Billups on Joe Dumars:

“To me, without Joe, it just looks incomplete. He's probably, overall, the greatest Piston. He brought the organization championships on both sides. For him to not be here, it's strange.”

Chauncey Billups on Joe Dumars, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @VinceGoodwill.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Joe Dumars, James Harden
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on James Harden:

“He reminds me a little bit of Joe Dumars,if you go way back. If James gets you on his hip, forget it.”

Steve Kerr on Joe Dumars, James Harden, Jan 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Josh Harrellson on Joe Dumars
item.description:
Josh Harrellson:

“After my workout, I was talking to Mr. Dumars and he was saying, ‘All the coaches like you. Everybody wants you to be our 15th guy and we’re going to make that happen.’Right then and there, I kind of knew they had interest and I know they were going to submit some kind of offer. I didn’t know if it was going to be ‘Come to camp and make the team like you have the previous two years,’ but they liked me enough to guarantee a little money and that gives me confidence in them and a better relationship.”

Josh Harrellson on Joe Dumars, Aug 23, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Trey Burke on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“A lot of people ask me where I want to play, I really don't care, it's just a blessing to be in the NBA. But I'd definitely want to play for the Detroit Pistons. I know Joe Dumars really well, the fan base is right there in Michigan.”

Trey Burke on Joe Dumars, May 15, 2013. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: George David on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“It would be a goal of mine to eventually do it, but I can honestly say that if the rest of my career path is simply being the No. 2 person to Joe Dumars, in a lot of ways I can honestly tell you that would be a complete career,”

George David on Joe Dumars, Aug 26, 2012. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“Joe Dumars has done a great job, as far as building that organization. I know a lot of people have talked about what the players did, and it was against the coach. But that's too disrespectful to Joe, for what he's done. He brought a lot of those guys in there, paid a lot of those guys. That's his organization.”

Flip Saunders on Joe Dumars, Mar 6, 2011. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Tayshaun Prince on Joe Dumars
item.description:
“But at the same time, if it did not pan out, of course I would want to finish the final 25 games. I've been through the good times and the bad times. I never once walked in there (to Dumars' office) and said I've got to go. I've struck through the thick and thin.”

Tayshaun Prince on Joe Dumars, Feb 22, 2011. Source: Detroit News.
